verdict.rationale: Ramp's OAuth 2.0 model offers granular resource:permission scopes, including a dedicated cards:read_vault scope for sensitive card data, and explicitly recommends least privilege ("configure only the scopes your app needs"). The client-credentials grant lets standalone agents authenticate without a browser. agents.ramp.com documents "one key per agent" tied to a human sponsor, with flexible per-agent permissions and full attribution. A live probe confirms the MCP server publishes granular read/write scopes, and Agent Cards issue merchant- and amount-scoped single-use credentials. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a scoped agent credential is actually issued and enforced.
